text:
A creature marked in black and white,
With stripes distinct, a living sight.

Within the garden’s quietude,
Nature spoke in softest mood,
Whispering secrets to the ear
Of those who pause to hear.

Flowers bloom with promise deep,
Their secrets in the petals keep,
Unfurling grace to show the splendor
Hidden close, a tender wonder.

Trees stand guard, silent and tall,
Sentinels of ancient call,
Leaves rustling with wisdom’s weight,
Of ages past, of time’s own fate.

Here in green, a haven found,
Solace in the simple ground,
Where growth unfolds, serene and slow,
In life’s perpetual, gentle flow.

Each bloom, each leaf that falls away,
Tells time’s unending, quiet story,
Of life’s cycle, wild and gloriou
